card.name: Linking words before a procedure or route
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, for, or, to, as) that come right before a procedure, route of use or site, such as neuraxial procedures, endometrial ablation, intravaginal use or colonoscopy.

modes.label: Before a procedure
modes.description: A linking word such as for, to or and sits just before a named medical procedure.
modes.example: care should be taken when dilating the cervix<< for>> endometrial ablation.

modes.label: In a list of routes
modes.description: The word or comes before the last route in a not-for-use list.
modes.example: It is not for oral, ophthalmic,<< or>> intravaginal use.

modes.label: Other setup words
modes.description: Words like original or single appear just before a noun that names a site or dose.
modes.example: EACH VIAL SHOULD BE USED FOR A<< SINGLE>> DOSE ONLY.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words that come just before the name of a procedure or route of use.
